title: From alarms to answers — AGIL® Secure ISMS V11 with AI Co-pilot
notes: Source of truth for narration and English subtitles. `en` is the subtitle text and `say` the spoken form fed to TTS; `|` splits both into the same subtitle cues (each spoken chunk is also synthesised alone to time the split). `pre` is the silence (s) before the line starts.

lines.en: 2:14 a.m. The airport never sleeps,|and neither does its security.
lines.say: Two fourteen, a.m. The airport never sleeps,|and neither does its security.

lines.en: Thousands of cameras, doors and sensors|report to one control room.
lines.say: Thousands of cameras, doors and sensors|report to one control room.

lines.en: Tonight: 1,248 alarms. Nine systems.|One operator.
lines.say: Tonight: twelve hundred and forty-eight alarms. Nine systems.|One operator.

lines.en: Is it real? Is it related?|Which camera? Which procedure? Who do I call?
lines.say: Is it real? Is it related?|Which camera? Which procedure? Who do I call?

lines.en: Meet AGIL Secure V11, with AI Co-pilot.
lines.say: Meet Agile Secure V eleven, with AI Co-pilot.

lines.en: The same console your team already knows,|now with answers built in.
lines.say: The same console your team already knows,|now with answers built in.

lines.en: Co-pilot detects, correlates and explains,|then recommends your own procedure, already filled in.
lines.say: Co-pilot detects, correlates, and explains,|then recommends your own procedure, already filled in.

lines.en: Then it stops. A person always makes the call.

lines.en: One night. Seven incidents,|already ranked by Co-pilot.
lines.say: One night. Seven incidents,|already ranked by Co-pilot.

lines.en: Two Critical. Four Warning. One Info.
lines.say: Two critical. Four warning. One info.

lines.en: Staff Door D-214. Five alarms become one incident:|one badge, two people, and the follower is heading airside.
lines.say: Staff door D two-fourteen. Five alarms become one incident:|one badge, two people, and the follower is heading airside.

lines.en: Co-pilot loads the procedure and tracks the follower.|One click locks the door, and the escalation comes pre-filled.
lines.say: Co-pilot loads the procedure, and tracks the follower.|One click locks the door, and the escalation comes pre-filled.

lines.en: Fence Sector 5. LiDAR sees one object, 1.7 metres tall.|Thermal confirms a person. A real intruder, not the wind.
lines.say: Fence sector five. Lidar sees one object, one point seven metres tall.|Thermal confirms a person. A real intruder, not the wind.

lines.en: Gate B12. An unattended bag, linked to its owner in six seconds,|by clothing, not by face.
lines.say: Gate B twelve. An unattended bag, linked to its owner in six seconds,|by clothing, not by face.

lines.en: Arrival Belt 5. Video and intercom audio agree: a fight is starting.|The nearest officers are 40 metres away.
lines.say: Arrival belt five. Video and intercom audio agree: a fight is starting.|The nearest officers are forty metres away.

lines.en: One card, two doors, four minutes apart.|The fastest route takes nineteen.

lines.en: Baggage Hall B2. Your own rules, running live:|after shift, outside duty, no overtime.
lines.say: Baggage hall B two. Your own rules, running live:|after shift, outside duty, no overtime.

lines.en: Rated Info: a radio check, not an alarm storm.
